title: Mexican Bean Soup
subtitle: with Quesadilla Dippers
description: Who knew veggie soup could be so good? We've put all our fave Mexican flavours together in a big and bold bowlful and teamed it with cheesy toasted quesadillas.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Finely chop the onion. Cut the capsicums into 1cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove. Drain and rinse the kidney beans. Finely grate the cheese.

Caramelise veggies: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over high heat. Cook the onion, garlic and a pinch of sugar, stirring, for 3 mins or until lightly caramelised. Add the capsicum and cook, stirring, for a further 6-8 mins until lightly charred. Add 1½ tsp Mexican spice blend and stir well.

Add stock and simmer: Meanwhile, crumble the stock cubes into a heatproof jug, add 500ml (2 cups) boiling water and 2 tbs tomato paste and stir to dissolve. Add the kidney beans and tomato stock to the veggies and bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 15 mins or until thickened slightly. Remove the pan from the heat.

Make quesadillas: Meanwhile, heat a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook 1 wrap for 1 min or until light golden underneath. Scatter with 2 tsp cheese and a large pinch of Mexican spice blend, then fold over to enclose the filling and cook for a further 30 secs or until the cheese is melted. Remove from the pan and cover to keep warm. Repeat with the remaining wraps, cheese and spice blend.
Serve up: Taste the soup, then season with salt and pepper. Scatter over the remaining cheese. Cut the quesadillas into triangles. Divide the soup among bowls and serve with the quesadilla dippers.
Make it yours: Dollop with a spoonful of mayonnaise, sour cream or even Greek-style yoghurt for a creamy flavour.
